name: Tendou Mako
source:
A woman who is the head nurse of a hospital. Although she is only in a position to organize the nurses, she has absolute power that even the office manager and the director, not to mention the doctors, cannot disobey.

It is said that she imposes harsh sanctions on any staff member she doesn't like, rumors about her criminal connections also circulate around.

She is seeking more power and financial resources, and is willing to use any means to achieve his goals.

She is the older sister of Mia Tendou.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/sakuseibyoto3/character/index.html]official site[/url]]
